note: The root key records the consonants of the place name. The verse gives no derivation.
summary: Calah is a city. Genesis lists it with Nineveh and Rehoboth-Ir among the places built.

senses.definition: The city named alongside Nineveh and Rehoboth-Ir in the account of their construction.

evidence.note: The phrase וְאֶת כָּלַח identifies Calah as the last of the places built.
